services.desc: If you’re searching for inshore fishing charters in Clear Lake TX, you’ve found the right place. Warrior Wave Charters specializes in the protected, fish-filled waters right in the heart of the upper Galveston Bay system - with a strong focus on Clear Lake itself. Captain Ken, a 24-year retired U.S. Marine Corps veteran, brings deep local knowledge to every trip. Based just minutes away at Waterman’s Harbor on Dickinson Bayou, he knows exactly where the fish are moving in Clear Lake’s grass flats, oyster reefs, and channel edges on any given day.
